'''2017 MPC Day 2 Ryan Jellison LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Jellison]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Jellison]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan 6.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/match-play-championship.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014113348/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
